patch.summary: Sellfy implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Sellfy by mapping current ecommerce workflows to Sellfy objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (priority systems) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on systems of record

blocks.heading: Sellfy day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Sellfy setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for core records before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Creators selling digital products before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate priority integrations before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Confirm live plan limits on sellfy.com
Do not expand seats until the pilot workflow is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Confirm live plan limits on sellfy.com

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Validate ecommerce fit before a deep Sellfy rollout
blocks.body: If Sellfy fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Sellfy object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on primary workflow
If blocked, evaluate Shopify before sunk-cost expansion

notes: Omit unsupported: pricing_expectations, plan_structure, capabilities, integrations, use_cases, testing_evidence
